subject: Anthropic Claude Platform computer use, browser use, Skills API, and Files API general availability, August 19-20 2026
central_claim: Anthropic's August 19-20 Claude Platform agent API release is a publishable AI engineering topic because official release notes and documentation show a concrete GA shift from beta or ad hoc agent components to an API-defined loop that combines computer use, browser use, Skills and Files; the article limits the conclusion to documented API structure and deployment design implications, not independent runtime performance or safety effectiveness.

selection.reason: The release affects concrete software-engineering decisions about production agents: tool execution loops, browser automation, organizational procedure packaging, file state, sandboxing, workspace isolation and human confirmation boundaries. It is same-day official product/API news with multiple primary URLs and a bounded E2 center claim.

claims.claim: Anthropic's August 19-20 Claude Platform agent API release moved computer use, browser use, Skills API and Files API into a documented production-agent surface: official release notes and docs support an E2 claim about API structure, agent-loop mechanics, state handling and deployment boundaries, but not independent performance or safety effectiveness.

Opened Claude Platform release notes. The August 19, 2026 entry records GA for computer_toolset_20260801, launch of browser_toolset_20260801, GA for Files API without files-api-2025-04-14 beta header, GA for Agent Skills and /v1/skills without skills-2025-10-02 beta header, plus related Managed Agents and console observability changes.

Opened Anthropic's August 20, 2026 product announcement. It frames computer use, browser use, Skills API and Files API as a production-agent bundle and describes how a claims agent could read files, apply a skill, operate an insurer portal and save a confirmation. Customer performance anecdotes were reviewed but not used as article performance evidence.

Opened official computer use docs. The page documents computer_toolset_20260801, GA status, 17 member tools, batch actions, agent loop, executor responsibilities, sandbox reference implementation path and security considerations including prompt injection, network allowlists, sensitive data restrictions and human confirmation.

Opened official browser use docs. The page documents browser_toolset_20260801, browser-specific agent loop, page-structure reading, element references, browser_state blocks, sequential handling of tool_use blocks and required tool_result echoing.

Opened official Agent Skills docs. The page documents Skills as filesystem-based instructions, metadata and optional resources; metadata is loaded first, SKILL.md is loaded when triggered, and additional files or scripts are read or run only when referenced.

Opened official Files API docs. The page documents upload-once/reference-by-file_id behavior, downloadable output boundaries, supported content blocks and the critical workspace-level access boundary for uploaded files.

Opened OpenAI GPT-5.6 August system-card update and the GPT-5.6 Sol preview path. These are important frontier-model surfaces but were already reviewed in recent AI판 work; the visible August 19 change was a correction to a GPT-5.5 pass@4 value and the remaining GPT-5.6 claims are vendor evaluations or previously covered safety context.

Reviewed OpenAI's August 18 frontier cyber-capability pacing post and August 20 AI Futures/product/customer surfaces. The pacing post is significant governance news but still lacks the promised technical report or deployable API/model artifact needed to outrank the selected Anthropic API release for SW-engineering utility.

Reviewed Gemini API changelog. Gemini 3.7 Flash GA on August 13, 2026 remains a strong official model release but was already covered by the 2026-08-14 AI regular edition; no newer Google model/API item found during this run outranked the selected candidate.

Reviewed Anthropic's Claude text watermark explainer. It is technically interesting and relevant to EU AI Act compliance, but the post is dated August 14, contains no public detector or implementation artifact, and is weaker for immediate SW-engineering decisions than the GA agent API bundle.

Reviewed known official surfaces for Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral and vLLM through current search and prior local decision ledgers. Qwen3.8, DeepSeek V4-Pro/Harness, Mistral Shieldstral/regional inference and vLLM 0.26.0 were already covered or stale for this publication slot; no new unhandled official artifact outranked the selected Anthropic API release.

Search results and related-post surfaces were used only to locate official paths across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral and vLLM. No article fact or scoring decision was based on search snippets, community posts or secondary summaries without opened primary-source confirmation.

claim_source_ledger.version: Computer use and browser use documentation for 20260801 toolsets; accessed 2026-08-20
claim_source_ledger.method: Read batch action and agent-loop sections in computer use docs and cross-checked browser use docs.

Article does not claim lower latency or higher task completion.

claim_source_ledger.claim: The browser use tool is a browser_toolset_20260801 client toolset that works in a browser viewport, reads page structure and returns element references that Claude can act on in later turns.
claim_source_ledger.version: Browser use tool documentation for browser_toolset_20260801; accessed 2026-08-20
claim_source_ledger.method: Read toolset overview, read_page example, browser_state result shape and agent-loop steps.

claim_source_ledger.claim: Agent Skills are filesystem-based instruction, metadata and resource bundles; Claude loads Skill metadata first and loads SKILL.md or referenced resources only when the Skill is triggered.
claim_source_ledger.method: Read Agent Skills overview sections on metadata, instructions, resources and progressive disclosure.
limitations: No custom Skill upload, versioning call or Skill execution was performed.
Trigger quality depends on Skill descriptions and model behavior.
conflict_of_interest: Anthropic authored the Agent Skills documentation.

claim_source_ledger.claim: The Files API lets callers upload files once, reference them by file_id in Messages requests and manage them at workspace scope; uploaded file IDs must not be accepted from untrusted end users because any API key in the same workspace can access files uploaded there.
claim_source_ledger.method: Read Files API overview, upload/reference flow and workspace access warning.
limitations: No file upload, retrieval, deletion or expiration behavior was tested.
Workspace limits and eligibility may vary by account.
conflict_of_interest: Anthropic authored the Files API documentation.

claim_source_ledger.claim: Anthropic's computer use documentation recommends a dedicated VM or container, sensitive-data limits, domain allowlists and human confirmation for consequential actions, and describes prompt-injection classifier defenses as an additional layer rather than a replacement for precautions.
claim_source_ledger.method: Read security considerations and prompt-injection mitigation notes.
limitations: The classifier's precision, recall and operational false-positive behavior are not independently verified.
The article does not claim compliance with Korean privacy or financial regulations.
